entities.name: Włodzimierz Sadalski

entities.summary: Włodzimierz Sadalski is a Polish former volleyball player and coach who was a member of the Poland national team from 1970 to 1977. During his career, he won gold medals at the 1974 FIVB World Championship and the 1976 Summer Olympics.
